title: ARCADE: DEATH RESPAWNS
why: His order of 2026-10-11, the 2 PLAYER ARCADE DEMO, build 3 of 20. In an arcade raid a death no longer ends the raid: going down and the death beat play out as always, then he drops back into the same raid with a fresh random loadout and full health, near a teammate who is up or else at the spawn farthest from every enemy, and stands still for a 3 second drop-in hold while the world runs on. Nothing is settled, no run is counted and no card comes up. Abandoning an arcade raid now just stops it, with no XP fee. A normal raid is exactly as it was.
now: In the arcade demo a death drops you back into the same raid with a fresh loadout after a 3 second hold.
